title: Sea Dependency Receipts
objective: Bind every embedded M4RI and igraph adapter and FFI manifest to an exact target-matched native dependency receipt and validate it fail-closed

oracles: Exact receipt identity and tamper rejection tests

handoff.summary: Embedded igraph and M4RI adapters are bound to exact, target-matched dependency receipts. Validation pins upstream source identity, public ABI header bytes, required installed outputs, native math profile, target ABI, deployment floor, and receipt identity; it revalidates the source prefix during SEA assembly to close staging races.
risks: Receipts provide trusted-packager provenance, not cryptographic proof that a final addon linked only the declared prefix bytes; independent reproducible builds remain the stronger future check.
next_steps: Integrate the two commits onto the shared release baseline and rerun the release-candidate gate with real Linux and macOS dependency receipts.
